doc: Golden fixture for EVENT_SCHEMA v1 (Issue #716). Pins docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md to a machine-checkable contract so indexers can detect consumer drift. Loaded and verified by bindings/tests/event-schema.v1.test.ts. Every event carries exactly two Symbol topics forming a canonical (namespace, action) pair; payload fields are positional and order-sensitive. Field `position` is 0-indexed and matches the positional tables in docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md.

events.description: Emitted when a new prediction round is opened.

fields.name: start_ledger
fields.description: Ledger sequence when the round was created

fields.name: bet_end_ledger
fields.description: Last ledger at which new bets are accepted

fields.name: end_ledger
fields.description: Ledger at or after which the round can be resolved

events.description: Emitted when a user places an Up/Down bet.
Emitted when a user submits a Precision mode price prediction.
Emitted when a user locks a Precision stake behind a commitment hash.
Emitted after a commitment is successfully opened during the reveal window. The salt is intentionally omitted.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: Round the revealed prediction belongs to

events.description: Emitted at competitive Precision settlement for each commitment that was not revealed.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User whose unrevealed commitment was forfeited

events.description: Canonical terminal round event emitted on every terminal transition (resolution, cancellation, fallback, void) with the full round state.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Terminal status: 0 = Resolved, 1 = Cancelled, 2 = FallbackRefund, 3 = Voided

fields.name: price_final
fields.description: Settlement price from oracle, or 0 for cancelled/fallback rounds

fields.name: fee_amount
fields.description: Protocol fees collected (stroops), 0 for non-competitive paths

fields.name: settled_at_ledger
fields.description: Ledger sequence when the round was archived

events.description: Emitted after a valid oracle result is staged and payouts/fees are deferred for the dispute window.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: Round awaiting a terminal dispute decision

fields.name: resolved_at_ledger
fields.description: Ledger where the oracle result was staged

fields.name: deadline_ledger
fields.description: First ledger where finalization is permitted

events.description: Emitted when any caller voids a staged round strictly before its deadline. Each participant is credited exactly their recorded stake.

fields.name: total_refund
fields.description: Sum of full-stake refunds in stroops

events.description: Emitted when any caller finalizes a staged round at or after its frozen deadline.
Emitted once per participant during round resolution after that participant's settlement outcome is known.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: Round that produced the participant outcome

fields.name: gross_payout
fields.description: Amount credited to pending winnings, in stroops

events.description: Emitted per losing participant on competitive settlement. Additive within schema v1.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Stake amount the user loses, in stroops

fields.name: side
fields.description: UpDown losing side: 0 = Up, 1 = Down. 0 for Precision mode

fields.name: predicted_price
fields.description: Precision guess (4 decimal places). 0 for UpDown or unrevealed

events.description: Emitted when a user successfully claims pending winnings.
Emitted when a new user mints their one-time initial vXLM allocation.
Emitted when the admin reconfigures the bet and run window lengths.

fields.name: bet_window_ledgers
fields.description: New bet-acceptance window in ledger counts

fields.name: run_window_ledgers
fields.description: New round-duration window in ledger counts

events.description: Emitted when the oracle records an on-chain liveness heartbeat.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Unix epoch seconds when the heartbeat was recorded

events.description: Emitted when the contract's emergency runtime mode is changed by the admin.

fields.name: old_mode
fields.description: Previous runtime mode: 0 = Normal, 1 = ClaimsOnly, 2 = Paused

fields.name: new_mode
fields.description: New runtime mode: 0 = Normal, 1 = ClaimsOnly, 2 = Paused

events.description: Emitted by every competitive-settlement path when the protocol fee is enabled.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: The id of the settled round

fields.name: fee_amount
fields.description: Stroops routed to the on-chain treasury this round

fields.name: treasury_balance
fields.description: Cumulative treasury balance AFTER this round's credit

fields.name: bps_active
fields.description: The fee's bps that produced fee_amount (echoes storage)

events.description: Emitted when a prediction round settles as a one-sided (degenerate) market.

fields.name: round_id
fields.description: Round that was settled as one-sided

fields.name: affected_side
fields.description: Side containing positions: 0 = Up, 1 = Down, 2 = Empty

fields.name: refund_amount
fields.description: Total stake refunded across all participants (stroops)

fields.name: carry_amount
fields.description: Total stake carried forward to next round (stroops)

fields.name: pool_up
fields.description: Total Up-side pool at settlement time (stroops)

fields.name: pool_down
fields.description: Total Down-side pool at settlement time (stroops)
